units.source_text: 这一天轮到我值班司厨。

en.t: That day it was my turn to be on kitchen duty.

units.source_text: 晚餐后，我在庙厨里洗涮碗感，

en.t: After dinner, I was washing bowls and dishes in the temple kitchen,

units.source_text: 无意中望了望早已静寂的食堂，

en.t: and happened to glance toward the dining hall, which had already fallen silent,

units.source_text: 只见食堂和庙后的交界处屹立着的被煤烟熏黑的柱子上，

en.t: and saw that on a soot-blackened pillar standing at the boundary between the dining hall and the rear of the temple,

units.source_text: 贴着一张几乎全变了色的条子。

en.t: there was a slip of paper pasted up, almost completely faded in color.
